memory_update.text: NBIS should be retained as the reference neocloud anchor for specialized AI cloud capacity, but not treated as underfollowed after major Microsoft, Meta, and NVIDIA disclosures.
IREN is a high-purity but now larger-cap AI cloud capacity candidate; key survival checks are power delivery, GPU financing, customer concentration, and AI cloud ARR conversion.
APLD maps to the adjacent powered-AI-data-center capacity chokepoint rather than GPU cloud ownership; CoreWeave lease execution and financing/dilution are the main evidence gates.

CIFR is a speculative-shadow candidate because its AI relevance is hidden inside a bitcoin-mining-to-HPC transition and depends on converting power pipeline into contracted, financed AI hosting projects.

For this node, the strongest evidence ladder is: signed multi-year customer contract with credit support, secured power/interconnection, GPU supply or tenant equipment path, project financing, deployment milestones, utilization, then margin after depreciation and financing.
Need a later Layer 2 pass on lease liabilities, debt covenants, GPU depreciation, SLA penalties, and customer concentration across NBIS, IREN, APLD, and CIFR before any prioritization survives.

node: Specialized AI cloud capacity and GPU-as-a-service infrastructure
summary: Expanded the universe around specialized AI cloud capacity and GPU-as-a-service infrastructure. The cleanest reference exposure is now Nebius, but the underfollowed discovery lane sits in companies that either converted crypto-mining/power assets into AI cloud capacity or supply powered AI data-center capacity to neocloud tenants. The key Serenity filter is not GPU ownership alone; survival requires evidence of contracted demand, power access, financing, execution capability, customer quality, and utilization.
